# Plugr

> Plugr is a fully managed workflow automation platform: a visual workflow canvas paired with an AI builder that discovers a connected integration's live actions and fields, drafts a flow from a plain-language description, and lets you inspect, validate, and test every step before it runs on a schedule or an event. Every run is recorded with step-level detail so a failed run can be inspected and retried.

Plugr connects to tools teams already use, including Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, HubSpot, OpenAI, Postgres, and webhooks. Connection credentials are encrypted at rest. Plugr runs as a fully managed cloud service — there is no server to provision, patch, or scale. Plugr does not offer a free trial; paid plans begin after payment, with a 3-day refund window for the first paid subscription.
